items.title: Leonard Farrow in Paradise
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Fifth-year RB Leonard Farrow's stellar football career was shaped by a unique upbringing that encouraged him to never give up.

items.title: 2026 Owls in the NFL - Week 10
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Week 10 of the 2026 NFL season is in the books with three Florida Atlantic football alumni seeing action. Here's a rundown of how each performed during the 10th week. (all game times listed below are Eastern):

items.title: Inside the Owls' Burrow S11, E14
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Inside the Owls' Burrow, the official weekly television show for Florida Atlantic Athletics, will air episode 14 of season 11 this week on Thursday, Nov. 19. Every 30-minute show this season will air on The Spot stations in the South Florida market.

items.title: Football Game Notes #11
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – The 2026 regular season is winding down, with the Bowl-eligible Florida Atlantic football team set for its home finale against South Florida on Saturday, Nov. 21. Kickoff on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium is set for 2:30 p.m. on ESPN+.

items.title: Messer Magic Shirt Available at On-Campus Store
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – For fans of Florida Atlantic football, 'Messer Magic' T-shirts highlighting the historic season by fifth-year WR Easton Messer are available to purchase in-person at the Follett Campus Store and online HERE.

items.title: Football's Kittley and Vasey to be Joined by Josh McCowan on the Weekly Radio Show
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. - The Florida Atlantic Coaches Show, presented by Duffy's Sports Grill, returns this Thursday, Nov. 19, from 6 to 7 p.m. at the Duffy's Sports Grill on St. Andrew's Boulevard in Boca Raton.

items.title: Valsin and Rooks to Join Kittley’s Weekly ESPN+ Presser
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by senior WR Kelby Valsin and graduate DB Tyson Rooks for a Tuesday, Nov. 16 press conference, airing live on ESPN+ at 12 p.m.

items.title: Kickoff Time at ECU Scheduled for 1 P.M.
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's 2026 regular season finale against East Carolina on Saturday, Nov. 28 is set for 1 p.m. on ESPN+, announced by the American Conference on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Messer Named Biletnikoff Award Semifinalist
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Easton Messer, Florida Atlantic football's dynamic fifth-year wide receiver, is one of 13 semifinalists for the Biletnikoff Award, as announced by the Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation, Inc. on Monday afternoon.

items.title: Florida Atlantic Stalls in Tulsa
items.summary: TULSA, Okla. – Florida Atlantic football fell to Tulsa on the road, 38-21, on Saturday evening.
